itineraries.title: Five days from Limassol to the Akamas
itineraries.intro: Limassol, Paphos and the Akamas peninsula.

days.note: Board at the marina; the castle and the wine villages in the hills behind.
The bay under the cliffs and the village on the ridge above it.
Lara Bay and the Blue Lagoon.

itineraries.title: Seven days around southern Cyprus
itineraries.intro: From the Akamas to Cape Greco along the south coast.

days.note: The Akamas peninsula and the Baths of Aphrodite, with the Blue Lagoon by tender.
Lara Bay and the turtle beach.
The Roman mosaics and the Tombs of the Kings; the harbour castle at sunset.
The bay under the cliffs and the village on the ridge above it.
Board at the marina; the castle and the wine villages in the hills behind.
The salt lake and the church of St Lazarus; disembark at the marina.
The sea caves at Cape Greco and the sands of Nissi beach.
